kind: code (tier B). Subagents read §3.1 (1029-1063) and §3.3 (1160-1302) — the transition tables are normative and tests hardcode them.

assertions.text: RUN_STATES, ITEM_STATES exactly as §3 draws them; blocked/deferred/debugging are item ANNOTATIONS, not ITEM_STATES members
full transition matrices: legal set exactly as §3.1/§3.3; every illegal pair rejected with a why naming the legal successor
GREEN requires {testExit:0} for behavioral items; GREEN with testExit 1 rejected
RED requires testExit!=0 AND failureClass in {assertion, missing-subject}; class error rejected; missing-subject ACCEPTED
PENDING->GREEN legal iff item.behavioral === false, rejected otherwise; PENDING->RED rejected for a non-behavioral item
a blocked item rejects EVERY transition with a why naming the question id
INTAKE->EXECUTING legal with classification trivial; EXECUTING->TRIVIAL_DONE only for trivial runs (rejected for work); EXECUTING->REPORTED rejected for trivial runs
PLAN_REVIEWED->EXECUTING and PLANNED->PLAN_REVIEWED both require {survivingMajors:0} or {round:>=max}
